jobs.title: AI Product Manager
jobs.description:
At Apple, new ideas and insights have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish. We are looking for an AI Product Manager who can combine product strategy, user insight, and technical understanding to lead the development and delivery of scalable, AI-powered digital solutions.

In this role, you will identify product opportunities through deep user understanding and data analysis, driving the integration of AI capabilities and intelligent agent systems to transform complex business workflows. You will work closely with engineering, data science, design, and business stakeholders to design user-centered systems. The ideal candidate is a strong collaborator who thrives in cross-functional environments and has a proven track record of bringing products from concept to successful launch.
- Design AI agents or agentic workflows to streamline and accelerate business process.
- Drive business needs to successful product implementations. Take full ownership of the product lifecycle, from concept development and prototyping to final launch and iteration.
- Facilitate communication and collaboration across different multi-functional groups and management levels. Bridge the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive all open items to closure.
- Identify user pain points and product opportunities through user research, behavioral analysis, and product analytics (e.g., retention, conversion, funnel drop-off).
- Explore opportunities to integrate AI capabilities, LLMs, or agent-based workflows to automate manual processes and empower existing systems.
- Maintain products in service, driving continuous iteration and optimization through experimentation, testing, and usage data.
- Establish product metrics frameworks to monitor AI product performance and translate data insights into concrete product requirements.
- Identify risks, generate mitigation plans, and ensure appropriate steps are taken to achieve desired timelines and successful product delivery.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
3+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of successful end-to-end product delivery and bringing products from concept to launch.
Exceptional cross-departmental communication and collaboration skills, with hands-on experience driving alignment across engineering, design, operations, and business teams.
Demonstrated ability to create product prototypes with strong product intuition and attention to user experience.
Strong analytical capabilities with proven experience in identifying user needs and using data to drive product decisions.
Familiarity with AI-powered product features, automation tools, or intelligent systems.
Experience working in Agile development environments.
Preferred qualifications:
Experience designing and delivering to-B (enterprise) products, internal tools, or PaaS platforms is a strong plus.
Hands-on experience working on AI/ML-related product initiatives, such as LLM-based applications, AI copilots, model integration, human-in-the-loop workflows, or ML-powered decision support tools.
Experience using or integrating AI tools and frameworks such as OpenAI APIs, LangChain, vector databases, or similar AI platforms.
Experience leading digital transformation projects, such as migrating legacy workflows or automating manual processes (e.g., finance, budgeting, or operational data workflows).
Experience with product analytics and experimentation frameworks, proficient in BI/visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Power BI).
Fluent in English with hands-on experience in end-to-end communication, including written documentation and live reporting in global/international business settings.
M.S. or B.S. in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Business, Economics, or a related field, with equivalent industry experience.

jobs.title: Pricing Product Manager
jobs.description:
Imagine what you can do here. Apple is seeking an exceptional product management leader to build the next generation of pricing features for our Services platform, including the App Store. Since its launch in 2008, the App Store has connected millions of developers to our devices, having now paid +$320 billion to developers who are connected to over 2 billion devices in 175 countries around the world. Today, there are more ways than ever for developers to monetize and distribute their apps in a secure and trusted way; and we’re just getting started!

This role will be responsible for defining and bringing to life new features that allow Apple and third-party developers to unlock the potential of their apps, in-apps, and subscriptions. You’ll design extensible systems that enable these features across a variety of use cases and lines of business, develop internal tooling to assist operations teams in launching and maintaining these features, and work in close partnership with cross-functional business, product, engineering and other stakeholders to turn business requirements into detailed technical specifications. In addition to meeting the business’ needs, you will be responsible for ensuring that the features you launch comply with the various legal, regulatory, tax and business requirements that come with operating a diverse, global digital goods marketplace.

The Pricing Product team plays a crucial role to provide developers with the tools and features they need to monetize their apps, acquire, and retain their customers. In this role, you will be an active participant in functional and technical design discussions, testing, and prioritization with global and cross-functional teams.
Key qualifications:
Minimum qualifications:
Exceptional communication skills: Can convey complex ideas concisely and effectively, adapt to different audiences, and influence outcomes.
Self-motivated and proactive: Willing to dive into details and gain a thorough understanding of Apple’s systems, processes, and strategic initiatives in order to build the best experiences for developers.
Strong analytical skills: Ability to break apart complex questions, seek expertise and data to arrive at a proposals
Proven record of working collaboratively with engineering, QA, design, business, finance and legal teams
5+ years of related experience in product management, consulting, design or engineering

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to contribute to our core vision and transform our existing workflows into Agentic AI systems in Manufacturing. You will be responsible for the product strategy, roadmap, and execution to streamline, analyze, and drive complex decisions across our manufacturing processes.

The Manufacturing Design team enables the mass creation of impossible products across Apple's entire product line, from iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. A key enabler of this success is a robust set of intelligent applications and autonomous systems designed to support the product lifecycle from prototype to announcement and beyond.

The applications we build are used daily by the teams managing Apple's supply chain and manufacturing. We collaborate closely with cross-functional partners to define and deliver reliable, 24/7 systems that solve complex challenges in producing the highest quality Apple products.
We work cross-functionally, and you will partner daily with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, designers, vendors, and stakeholders to build impactful, intelligent software products. We believe in going deep on user research and data analysis to decide where we should go next with our products, we believe in delivering iterative features quickly and continuously improving our products and processes, and we are a strong design and product-led organization. We love talking to and working with our users every day to enable them to do their best work.

8+ years of industry experience on software product teams (Product, Design, or Engineering), including at least 5+ years specifically in Product Management.
Exceptional written and oral communication skills in English.
User-Centric mindset, and the demonstrated ability to define and build intentional product processes that are shared cross-functionally.
Demonstrated ability to craft and effectively communicate a product vision, strategy, and roadmap, and the ability to inspire the product team to execute upon these artifacts.

Demonstrated ability to work closely with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, and designers, engage in thoughtful and respectful debate, and prioritize among competing needs.
